title: 上架感言
content_zh:
上架感言-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

存书签

下一章

明天就要正式上架了，说实话，现在我的心里只有一个想法：

终于把这段剧情写完了。

讲真的，这本书从一开始我就没打算写成所谓的民俗文，当然在一开始它会有非常非常多的民俗元素，后面也还会有。

但民俗毕竟不是主线，灵异的元素也只是作为点缀。

我想要写的，本质上还是一个“大科幻”。

所以在整个新书期，我一直都在尝试用更好的方式把从“民俗”这个切入点开始，去为大科幻做铺垫。

到今天，整个铺垫的过程终于完成。

怎么说呢，铺垫的剧情确实没有那么完美，因为篇幅有限，我又想着必须要在上架之前完成所有铺垫，把世界观彻底改造出来。

所有有些剧情就显得急，有些又显得莫名其妙。

还是第一次写这种题材，没有太多经验。

不过嘛，这本书从这里开始，才算是正式开始。

我对后面的剧情很有信心，可以说是非常非常有信心，因为故事终于可以展开来写了。

新书期的内容，实在是有点束手束脚的。

所以不管怎么说，感谢大家对这本书的支持，这本书目前近5000的追读，非常不错。

也希望上架之后大家继续支持。

上架后的内容、元素会更加丰富，爽点会更加多样、更加集中，主角的成长主线，也会真正开始加强。

他的迷茫期已经结束了，接下来，就是一步一步向上走，去解开这个世界的真相了。

-----

根据以往的经验，作者如果更新太多的话，质量有可能下降。

所以我这里还是不做太多更新的承诺，只能保证日更6000以上，偶尔万更。

当然，如果写得特别顺的话，也是会加更的。

总之肯定不会有稿子不发----你让我写完了不发，我也忍不住。

大家如果有月票的话多投一投，让我们一起来看一看，这本书到底能走多远。

感谢！

Remarks on the launch - "I discovered a bug in the world"

It will be officially launched tomorrow. To be honest, I only have one thought in my mind right now:

Finally finished writing this plot.

To be honest, I did not intend to write this book as a so-called folklore article from the beginning. Of course, it will have many, many folklore elements at the beginning, and there will be more later.

But after all, folklore is not the main line, and the supernatural elements are just embellishments.

What I want to write is essentially a "big science fiction".

Therefore, throughout the new book period, I have been trying to use a better way to pave the way for science fiction starting from the entry point of "folklore".

As of today, the entire paving process is finally completed.

How can I put it, the plot foreshadowing is really not that perfect, because the space is limited, and I thought that all the foreshadowing must be completed before it is released on the shelves, and the world view must be completely transformed.

Some of the plots seemed urgent, and some seemed inexplicable.

This is my first time writing about this kind of subject, so I don’t have much experience.

But, this book only officially begins from here.

I am very confident about the subsequent plot, I can say that I am very, very confident, because the story can finally be unfolded and written.

The content of the new book issue is really a bit constrained.

So anyway, thank you all for supporting this book. This book currently has nearly 5,000 readers, which is very good.

I also hope that everyone will continue to support it after it is released.

After it is released, the content and elements will be richer, the fun points will be more diverse and concentrated, and the protagonist's main line of growth will really begin to strengthen.

His period of confusion is over, and the next step is to move forward step by step to uncover the truth about the world.

-----

Based on past experience, if the author updates too much, the quality may decline.

So I still don’t make too many updates commitments here. I can only guarantee more than 6,000 updates per day, and occasionally 10,000 updates.

Of course, if the writing is particularly smooth, updates will be added.

In short, there will definitely be no manuscripts that will not be published - even if you ask me not to publish them after I finish them, I can't help it.

If you have a monthly vote, please vote more. Let's take a look at how far this book can go.

grateful!
